exit_state: Compression must preserve joint paths, information and query-relevant memory; outer and inner bounds answer different questions. Approximate inference requires a declared target measure, persistent parameters, support-covering proposals and diagnostics beyond particle weights. Rare-event absence and conditional severity do not identify unconditional safety or breach probability.
